title: Constructive Lean 4 and Zero-Float Exact Rational Certificates for the Thermodynamic Budget of Objectivity and Biological Resource Horizons
abstract: We present a constructive Lean 4.35.0 formalization and zero-float exact-rational verification framework (THERMO-OBJECTIVITY-CERT-1.0) for the exact algebraic, combinatorial, and thermodynamic inequalities governing objective classical records established by Chung (arXiv:2611.34909v1, Nov. 2026), together with an explicit quantitative bridge to bioenergetic maintenance horizons (ARR-2025-2AQXS44H6Z8GQAG2). Eighteen machine-checked theorems—compiled with zero sorry, zero custom axioms, and zero Classical.choice—certify the nonnegativity and source-preservation algebra of the Landauer-linear creation bound W >= R k_B T ln 2 (1-delta) H(epsilon), decreasing c_1/M staircase excess via constructive rationals, the exact binary-symmetric-channel convolution inverse e_1* = (e*-q)/(1-2q) and critical-angle impossibility beyond theta_c = 2 arcsin sqrt(H_2^{-1}(delta)), the adversary access threshold k_min = R - R_min + 1, inter-record parity work extraction W_ext = (k-1) k_B T ln 2, the event-inclusive sector second law Sigma_{eA} = Sigma_A + I_i - I_f, zero-gap thermal permutation invariance and (D,M) contrast-polarization swapping, the branch-averaged Cauchy-Schwarz emergence speed limit 2 Sigma A >= B^2, the exact factor-R parallel-broadcast advantage, maintenance-power scaling, intersubjectivity agreement bounds, and SI-2019 adiabatic drift-filter flight arithmetic. A zero-float Python verifier audits 16 canonical certificates across four verification modes using certified rational series brackets for ln, log_2, H_2, multi-copy noisy BSC mutual information, and (f/2)coth(f/2), passing 33 unit, forgery-rejection, and AST tests.
